sloka: तेन पित्रा ऽहमप्यत्र नियुक्त: पुरुषर्षभ ।चतुर्दश वने वासं वर्षाणि वरदानिकम् ॥ २.१०७.७॥
transliteration: tena pitrā 'hamapyatra niyukta: puruṣarṣabha ।caturdaśa vane vāsaṁ varṣāṇi varadānikam ॥ 2.107.7॥

translations.english: O best of men, that is why I have been ordered by father to live in the forest for fourteen years as per the (condition of the) boon.
